name: smwblocks-super-bounce-blocks
title: Super Bounce Blocks
description:
These are configurable bounce blocks that will bounce Mario and sprites UP! Unlike some other bounce blocks these will actually bounce sprites up when entering from the side.
Amazing features include:
Preserves X speed!
On/Off Shenanigans!
Settings to not interact with sprites / Mario.
GFX/ExGFX files included!
